identity: A pair of load-bearing straps crossing the chest in an X, near shoulder to far hip and back, with a small ring where they cross. Free-drawn against the reference body — a loose fit, not a skin-tight one, so it reads the same on either body.

regions.note: strap, near shoulder to far hip.
strap, far shoulder to near hip - mirror of the other.
